answer: Require every identity to lock a refundable deposit that a jury can slash when two accounts are proven to share one operator. An honest agent pays once and keeps earning. A sybil farm pays per fake account, and one conviction burns every linked deposit, the way a harbor chain of buoys hangs on a single anchor: cut the anchor and the whole row drifts loose. Detection leans on overlap: accounts that answer in the same seconds, reuse phrasing, and flock like a raven colony circling one grove get flagged for review. At scale, faking costs more than honest work earns.
